project_type: Python CLI that generates Fly91 weekly AWS BAU reports as Excel (.xlsx) and Word (.docx)
language: Python 3.9.25 (must stay 3.9 compatible: typing.Optional/Union, NO 'X | None' PEP 604 unions)
build_system: none (pure Python). Dependencies in requirements.txt installed via pip
test_framework: no pytest suite; verification is via standalone scripts in scripts/ (verify_word_report.py, verify_word_live_fallback.py) plus running the CLI with --mock
verification_instructions: 1) pip install -r requirements.txt. 2) Generate docx with --mock --format docx. 3) Run scripts/verify_word_report.py (extended with design assertions) against the generated file; loop fix->regenerate->re-verify until ALL checks PASS. 4) Run --format both and default (xlsx-only) to confirm no Excel regression. 5) Programmatically unzip the docx and confirm: word/document.xml contains w:vMerge markers in the cost table, a gridSpan/merged leading cell on the Total Cost row, an underlined (w:u) centered title run, the cover page has >=1 embedded cover/logo image, header date-range text ('07th Sep' / '14th Sep' style two-line bold) present, pgSz is Letter (w:w=12240 w:h=15840) and margins match the reference section.
snapshot_or_generated_files: demo/*.docx and demo/*.xlsx are generated outputs. *.docx, *.xlsx and *.png are gitignored (except the committed Aptech reference docx) so any asset images used by the report AND the regenerated demo docx must be force-added with 'git add -f'. Inspector/GuardDuty console-style screenshots are generated at runtime by report/screenshots.py (Pillow); optional EC2 metric charts by report/metric_charts.py (matplotlib).
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt (boto3, botocore, openpyxl, Pillow>=10, matplotlib, python-docx>=1.1). Python 3.9.25.
environment_constraints: Sandbox has no AWS access and no AWS CloudShell; always test with --mock. The DESIGN (table structure, merges, cover, fonts, borders, page size) is DATA-AGNOSTIC: only cell VALUES come from collected_data, so the layout must render identically for mock and real data. To prove design is independent of the mock flag, feed a 'real-shaped' (non-mock-looking) dataset if needed. python-docx cannot create a true full-bleed floating page-background image easily; approximate the cover (image sized to page, logo top-right, blue left accent bar) and DOCUMENT the limitation.
contribution_requirements: Work on branch feat/word-report-design-match (already created from latest main). Commit the asset images used (git add -f) and the regenerated demo docx (git add -f). Do NOT push, do NOT open a PR, do NOT re-clone. Keep Python 3.9 compatible.
key_patterns: report/word_report.py (python-docx) is the ONLY file that builds the Word doc. Sections are a list of (name, func, kwargs) each wrapped in try/except for graceful degradation. Cost table built in _build_cost_summary_differences; cover in _build_cover; low-level cell helpers _set_header_row/_bold_cell at the bottom. Config comes from config.json -> word_report{}. Image embedding uses doc.add_picture(buf-or-path, width=Inches(..)). To emit raw OOXML (vMerge, underline, gridSpan, borders, pgSz/pgMar, floating background) use python-docx oxml: from docx.oxml.ns import qn; from docx.oxml import OxmlElement; cell._tc, run._r, section._sectPr. For cell vertical merge python-docx also exposes cell_a.merge(cell_b).

scripts/verify_word_report.py  (EDIT: add design assertions - vMerge, underline title, gridSpan Total Cost, cover+logo images, two-line bold date headers, pgSz/pgMar)
config.json  (EDIT: add word_report.assets mapping: logo, cover_background, inspector/guardduty/overview screenshots - all optional, code falls back gracefully)

assets/cover_background.png  (OPTIONAL cover cityscape - NOT present in reference set; user supplies their own; code must render cover without it if missing)

assets/screenshots_cost_overview.png, screenshots_inspector_{critical,high,medium,low}.png, screenshots_guardduty.png  (representative AWS console captures copied from reference images; configurable swap for real Fly91 captures)
assets/reference_images/  (48 PNGs extracted from the reference docx; source for the stable-named assets above)

directory_structure: report/ = all report generators (word_report.py is Word; excel_generator.py + *_sheet.py are Excel; screenshots.py, metric_charts.py render embedded images). scripts/ = standalone verifiers. assets/ = images (reference_images/ raw extracts + stable-named asset copies). demo/ = generated sample reports. config.json = client/report config. weekly_bau_report.py = CLI. utils/ = helpers (format_currency, format_count, format_date_range, get_previous_period).

design_findings.page_size: US Letter: w:pgSz w:w=12240 w:h=15840 (twips). Reference first section pgMar: top=1340 right=0 bottom=1160 left=360 header=0 footer=970 (twips). Current generated docx uses default pgMar top/bottom=1440 left/right=1800 - should be tightened toward the reference.
design_findings.cover_reality: The committed reference .docx cover is actually the OPERISOFT LOGO (image1.png) scaled large on page 1 on a plain white page - there is NO cityscape photo anywhere in the 48 extracted images (images 1-8 are logos/badges; images 9-48 are white-background AWS console screenshots). The user's screenshot shows a city-skyline cover, but that asset is NOT in the reference material. Therefore: render the cover with logo top-right + blue left accent bar + title, and treat the cityscape as an OPTIONAL configurable background (assets/cover_background.png) that is absent by default; document this gap so the user can supply their own cityscape.
design_findings.logo: assets/logo.png = reference image1.png = color 'Operisoft' wordmark (349x159). image8.png is a smaller Operisoft logo. These carry Operisoft branding - note in README they should be swapped for the client's Greatworx logo.
design_findings.screenshots: image9=Cost Explorer overview; image13/15/17/19/21 = representative colorful AWS console captures used for Inspector severities + GuardDuty. They carry Aptech account data - note in README to replace with real Fly91 captures.
design_findings.cost_table_target: Single bordered (Table Grid) table. Header row: col0 header 'No' rendered STACKED as 'N' over 'o' (line break in cell); then 'Account Name','Account ID','Services'; then 'Last Week' (bold) with second line '07th Sep - 13th Sep)' date range; 'Current Week' (bold) with second line '(14th Sep - 20th Sep)'. The No / Account Name / Account ID cells for the first service row must be VERTICALLY MERGED (w:vMerge) spanning ALL service rows so the account identity reads as one tall cell ('1' / account name / account id) - NOT blank per row as currently coded. Final 'Total Cost' row: leading columns (No..Services) merged into one centered bold cell 'Total Cost'; cost cols read '($728.33 Tax Excluded Cost)' / '($705.25 Tax Excluded Cost)'. Cost cells centered. Then analysis bullets follow.
design_findings.title_target: 'Cost Summary Differences' title must be CENTERED and UNDERLINED (run.underline=True, paragraph center).
design_findings.media_baseline: Current demo docx embeds 5 images (word/media/image1-5 = Inspector 4 severities + GuardDuty). After adding cover logo (and optional cover bg), word/media should have >=6; verify cover logo image present on page 1.
